advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Correct the doc to state that `reducer/_replay.py` dispatches the `process_*` processors that are DEFINED in `reducer/_processors.py` (and `_processors_identity.py`), rather than saying the process_* functions belong to `_replay.py`.
evidence: docs/event-schema.md:40: "Replay dispatch is defined by `reducer/_replay.py` and its `process_*` functions."

src/rebar/reducer/_replay.py:6-8: "...over the flat ``_EVENT_HANDLERS`` table over the ``process_*`` processors (pass 2). The per-event fold logic itself lives in :mod:`._processors`; this module only owns the scan / dispatch / snapshot-short-circuit machinery..."
docs/event-schema.md:209: "`reducer._replay` has no handler for the event" — the handlers are defined in `_processors`, dispatched by `_replay`.
advisory.finding: The doc attributes the `process_*` fold functions to `reducer/_replay.py`, but per `_replay.py`'s own module docstring those processors live in `reducer/_processors.py`; `_replay.py` owns only the scan/dispatch/snapshot machinery and imports the `process_*` functions from `_processors`.
scenarios: A maintainer following the doc looks in _replay.py for a process_* handler and does not find its body there.
advisory.suggested_fix: Reword line 40 to e.g. "Replay dispatch lives in `reducer/_replay.py`, which folds each event through the `process_*` processors defined in `reducer/_processors.py`."
